acceptanceCriteria: Registration file committed before the 30th map; the run reports the metric with interval, grep-bot arm and held share; outcome recorded in a build-log entry as PASS or KILL.
body:
Panel finding (eval-method). The planned rerun over the migrated maps has an expected delta of exactly 0: the migration left 613 maps byte-identical and V1-1263/V1-1264 are criterion neutrality and receipt authentication, not base selection. Picking those lanes as improvement targets from the evaluation set is tuning on observed cases (2026-10-12-cem-citation-baseline-593-maps.md:50).
Proposal: commit a registration first (next 30 class=change post-cutover maps, scorer sha256, seed=patchSha256); primary metric pooled excess anchored over a 200-derangement null with diff-adjacent bases excluded; baseline 2.1% [1.7%, 2.5%]; improvement only if the lower bound beats 2.5% and grep-bot parity is not reached; kill if excess <= 2.1% or diff-adjacent share > 25%. Run the P2 held falsifier (decision 0523 K1, >=25% held) on the same 30 maps: held is the only tier a grep bot cannot manufacture.

title: Preregistered prospective citation measurement over the next 30 post-cutover change maps (replaces the migrated-map rerun as the informative measure)
